rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously described situation
manner adverb indicating the state described in the preceding verse
object of the gerund ālokya; refers to King Sagara
absolutive expressing prior action of Vasiṣṭha
subject of the clause; the sage addressed for refuge

items.question: How did Brahmā-born Vaśiṣṭha perceive King Sagara in that dire condition?
premises: King Sagara was previously described as swooning with sword raised.
Vaśiṣṭha is identified as born from Brahmā.
Vaśiṣṭha observed the king in that specific state.
items.inference: Brahmā-born Vaśiṣṭha beheld King Sagara in that condition.
items.plain_english: Seeing the king in that condition, Vaśiṣṭha, born of Brahmā, [beheld him].
